notes: The gloss «يعني ابن عمرو» is left out; the bare «محمد» is the third occurrence of that word
Abu Dawud's remark «قال حدثنا محمد بن عمرو عن الزهري عن عروة عن عائشة» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route
Appended remarks (Anas b. Sirin, Makhul, Hammad, Yunus, al-Taymi, Ibn Sirin) carry other sayings or opinions and are not routes of this saying; left out
